model_annotation: Figure 10 illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis, labeled “Language family,” displays a linear scale ranging from “IE-Baltic” to “Urals,” with tick labels indicating each family. The vertical axis, labeled “effect,” displays a linear scale ranging from -10 to 10, with tick intervals of 1. The bars represent the effect of context masking on case tasks for each language family. The tallest bar, corresponding to “rBERT-B,” has a value of approximately 20, while the shortest bar, corresponding to “IE-Indic,” has a value of approximately 0.1. “rBERT-L,” “rBERT-R,” “rBERT-B,” “rBERT-X,” “rBERT-L-L,” “rBERT-L-R”, “rBERT-B-B” and “rBERT-X-B” bars are colored green, red, blue, yellow, orange, purple and brown, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and none are visually emphasized.
